default library exposes both tabs without changing work; optical apparatus can be placed directly and domain replacement is cancellable
touch switches categories, cancels pending placement and keeps the two libraries within the page
physical apparatus and single-cell battery preview replace symbols; loose wire can be dropped, moved, bent and rewired

hand-copied estimates, missing values and explicit corrections never get overwritten by model truth
